title: EZVideoRepair — Focused video restoration, entirely on your Mac
description: Local video and image restoration for Apple Silicon Macs. Preview two seconds before processing a full video. Keep your media on your Mac, save projects, and resume interrupted work.
headline: Restore your footage.
Right on your Mac.
intro: A focused, fully local video restoration tool. Improve videos and images with EZVR Flash V1 while keeping your media on your Mac, from preview to export.
availability: Source code and model weights are available. A public app installer is not yet available.
hero_note: Preview first. Keep your media local.

features: Generate a two-second preview from the selected time. Check it before processing the whole video.
Restore a full video or set a custom duration. Work on just the part you need.

model_title: Get the model. Then go offline.
model_intro: EZVR Flash V1 is a SeedVR2 3B-derived weight package for this app. Downloaded files are checked for integrity before they can be used.
model_note: Getting the model requires Internet access. Restoration can run offline once the model is ready.
requirements: About 7.79 GB for weights, plus space for downloads, outputs and projects
faq: Are my videos uploaded to a server?
No. Videos and images are processed on your Mac. Obtaining models makes network requests to the hosting service, but does not upload your media.
Does it work on Intel Macs or Windows?
Restoration currently supports Apple Silicon Macs only. Intel Macs and Windows are not supported.
The current model targets a 512-pixel short edge. There is no promise of 4K, 8K or frame interpolation. Some outputs may be smaller than the original; check a preview first.
It depends on your Mac, the media and its duration. Processing may take much longer than playback. Start with a two-second preview to decide how much to process.
Does a project include the original media and model?
No. It references the original media and keeps settings, results and restored frames from unfinished tasks. Keep the original media and model separately when moving a project.
Where can I download the app?
The project source is available on GitHub and model weights on Hugging Face. This page does not link to an unreleased installer or an App Store listing.
closing_text: A focused Mac tool for better-looking footage. Start with a short preview.
footer_line: A focused, fully local video restoration tool
footer_notice: Results vary by source media. EZVR Flash V1 is a SeedVR2-derived weight package, not an official upstream product.
